capabilities: Build six local indexes (UUID, term, tag co-occurrence, n-gram, relation graph, document stats) over vault markdown
Rank related notes by combining BM25, tag similarity, term overlap and graph proximity scores
Suggest relations and write them into the related: frontmatter field
Auto-add UUID id fields to notes or add them per note via command
Query the indexes with an optional dependency-free CLI tool
disambiguation: Despite the RAG framing, it calls no AI services; all indexing and scoring run locally, and Claude Code integration is optional.
extras: Manifest carries the warning "This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff." Auto-add UUIDs modifies note files and is off by default; notes without an id field are excluded from indexing.
problem: Obsidian's search and backlinks are keyword- and link-based, with no offline semantic-style retrieval or scored related-note discovery.

relations.evidence: Smart Relations indexes are designed to work with Claude Code for RAG-style queries over your vault.

summary: Local RAG indexing plugin that builds offline search indexes over vault notes and ranks related notes using BM25, tag, term-overlap and graph-proximity scores.
